YOUR PHOTOS, YOURS ONLY

Your photos stay on your device.
We use only the information we need.

This policy explains what Kikoo processes on your device and what information it uses to operate the service.

Effective November 9, 2026

Three promises to start

  • User images, photos, and videos are not sent to or stored in the company's or its service providers' cloud.
  • We process only the basic information needed to operate the service, such as purchase, coin, account, and basic usage information.
  • We do not sell photos or use them for advertising or AI training.

On this page

1. Scope and contact 2. User images, photos, and videos stay off the cloud 3. Basic information needed to operate the service 4. External sharing and device backups 5. Service providers and disclosure 6. Retention and deletion 7. Your rights and information security 8. Changes and contact

1. Scope and contact

This policy applies to the Kikoo Selfie Club (Kikoo) app and this website, provided by Cigncloud (the ‘Company’). For privacy questions or requests to exercise your rights, send a DM to @kikioo_selfie_club on Instagram.

2. User images, photos, and videos stay off the cloud

The Company does not upload, transmit, or store images, photos, videos, camera frames, previews, thumbnails, original stickers, or edited results that you capture or import to the Company's or its service providers' servers or cloud. This includes encrypted and temporary files.

Capture, face and body recognition, background removal, effects, and editing are processed on your device. Information derived from media during these processes, such as facial or body landmarks and masks, is not sent to the cloud. We do not build a facial recognition database or use media for advertising or AI training.

Camera and photo library permissions are used for capture, import, and saving that you choose. Microphone permission is used for capture features that need sound. You can change permissions in iOS Settings; features that need a permission may be unavailable if you deny it.

3. Basic information needed to operate the service

Not collecting photos does not mean that we collect no information. To provide and operate the service safely, the Company processes the following information as needed:

Account and authentication

Account identifier, sign-in provider identifier, email if provided, authentication and account-link status

Sign-in, account verification, and syncing supported service status across devices

Purchase verification

Apple transaction and product identifiers, transaction verification information, purchase and refund status, and the account linked to a purchase

Verify purchases, prevent duplicate grants, confirm purchases, and reflect refunds

Coins, entitlements, and rewards

Coin balance and grant, use, and adjustment records; owned content; and challenge and reward progress summaries

Grant and deduct coins, provide content entitlements, and restore rewards and service status

Basic usage and error information

App and OS versions, device type, app installation identifier, account identifier, feature, screen, and content usage events and settings, error status, and technical information such as IP address during connection

Usage statistics, feature improvement, troubleshooting, security, and abuse prevention

Customer support

Instagram username and profile, messages, and app, device, or transaction information you provide

Respond to questions, investigate transaction or error reports, and process privacy requests

Apple processes payments. The Company does not receive your full card number, financial account password, or Apple Account password. Do not attach personal photos or videos, passwords, or complete payment details to a support request.

We use Google Analytics for Firebase (GA4) for basic in-app usage statistics. Events do not include original photos, videos, audio, or facial landmarks. Statistics may be linked to an app installation identifier or account identifier, so we do not describe all statistics as anonymous. Approximate location information may be derived from an IP address. See the usage information notice under ‘Settings → Usage Information’ in the app.

4. External sharing and device backups

Saving to your photo library, using the system share sheet, or transferring between devices with a friend happens when you choose to do so. These actions do not mean the Company collects or stores your photos in its cloud.

Whether an exported photo or video is saved to iCloud Photos, a device backup, or a sharing service depends on your settings and that service's policy. Copies kept or reshared by a recipient are managed by that recipient and service.

The Company does not provide photo cloud backup and cannot restore photos from its servers if they are lost because a device is lost or the app is deleted. Export anything you want to keep to a location of your choice.

5. Service providers and disclosure

For the purposes above, the Company uses account and transaction infrastructure, Apple (sign-in, in-app purchases, and transaction verification), Google (basic usage statistics), and Instagram/Meta (customer support by Instagram DM). The website is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may process technical information such as IP addresses to operate the hosting service. This website does not install separate advertising or analytics tracking scripts.

If you contact us on Instagram, the profile information and messages you send are processed under Instagram/Meta's policies. Please use DM instead of posting account or transaction details in a public comment.

Non-media service information may be processed by service providers outside your country. Where applicable law requires a separate notice or consent, that process will be followed. Contact us using the privacy contact above with questions about a particular processing activity. User images, photos, and videos are not included in these processing activities.

We do not sell personal information or provide it for targeted advertising. If disclosure is required by law or a lawful request, it is limited to the required scope.

6. Retention and deletion

You can manage and delete media on your device and in your photo library. Deleting the app does not automatically delete copies you separately saved to your photo library.

Account and service information is kept for as long as needed to provide the service. When the purpose is fulfilled or a valid deletion request is processed, information is deleted or de-identified. Limited transaction and accounting records that must be kept by law, and records needed for disputes, security, or abuse prevention, may be retained separately for the required legal basis and period.

To request deletion, send a DM to @kikioo_selfie_club on Instagram. We will verify the requester and explain what can be deleted and what must be retained by law. Do not send a password or ID photo. Deleting an account does not delete photos from your device, photo library, or external sharing services.

7. Your rights and information security

Depending on applicable law, you may request access to, correction or deletion of, or restriction of processing of your personal information, or withdraw consent. Requests may also be made through a legal representative. A request may be limited for information needed to provide the service or retained by law; if so, we will explain why.

Where applicable law requires additional conditions, such as parental consent for processing a child's personal information, we follow those requirements. A parent or guardian may contact us with questions or request deletion of a child's personal information.

The Company uses appropriate safeguards, including access restrictions and authenticated communications. Operational information is used only for the purposes described in this policy.

8. Changes and contact

If app features or information practices change, we will update this page and its effective date. We will provide notice of changes that materially affect your rights as required by applicable law.

Privacy contact: Cigncloud · Instagram DM at @kikioo_selfie_club
